title: Quantum Random Beacons Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Quantum Random Beacons: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Quantum Random Beacons — public randomness from quantum physics.

Phase 1 — Prove (QRNG arrays): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (beacon logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (certification): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (lottery-grade trust): beacon hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and internet-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
